description: Fixture set for the release-ship freeze idempotency contract group of tools/ci/test_workflow_jq_contracts.sh (section 5, 2026-11-02). The freeze ⑥ check consumes `gh api --paginate repos/.../releases` whose output SHAPE is gh-version-dependent (page bodies printed as a single merged array vs. concatenated documents), and the freeze ⑤ check pins the idempotency judgment table (same tag+same SHA = NO-OP / same tag+different SHA = FAIL / absent = proceed / unclear = fail-closed). This directory is a separate case group — it shares nothing with the sibling canary/router fixtures in the parent directory, so parallel contract work cannot collide.

measured.result: [] — the repository holds ZERO published releases at capture time (2 bytes)
measured.role: verbatim empty-array page; also live evidence that `gh api --paginate` on a single empty page emits ONE array document (local single-page observation)

synthesized.shape: two JSON-array documents; p1 rows tag_name v0.5.4/v0.5.5, p2 row tag_name v0.5.6
synthesized.why: the killing shape for the pre-fix ⑥ program is the DOCUMENT BOUNDARY (two array docs concatenated on the stream), which cannot be captured live on a repository with fewer releases than one page (measured: 0 releases). The stream `cat p1 p2` emulates the legacy gh --paginate concatenated-document output; the negative control in the harness asserts the pre-fix program emits a multi-line count on exactly this stream, so the killing shape cannot be silently sanitized away.
synthesized.rows_note: rows are schema-faithful subsets of the List-releases response (id/tag_name/name/draft/prerelease/created_at/published_at/author/html_url/target_commitish + url family); the freeze contract consumes tag_name only — extra fields exist to keep rows realistic, not as contract surface

synthesized.shape: one non-array (object) document — GitHub error-envelope field set
synthesized.why: pins the fail-closed path: a --paginate stream that is not entirely array documents must be a jq error (non-zero exit), never a silent count
empty stdin boundary — jq -s yields the empty accumulator, count 0, proceed
zero-release boundary in array form — count 0, proceed

harness_built_objects.note: git refs / git tags response bodies used by the ⑤/⑦ scenarios are built in-harness (not committed) because they encode the SCENARIO MATRIX (which SHA each tag points at), not measured repository state

schema_basis.claim: GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/git/ref/tags/{tag} → {ref, object: {sha, type}} where type is "commit" (lightweight) or "tag" (annotated; sha = tag object OID)
schema_basis.authority: docs.github.com/en/rest/git/refs (Get a reference); annotated peel via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/git/tags/{tag_sha} → {sha, tag, object: {sha, type: "commit"}}

determinism: All fixtures are committed static files; the harness performs zero network calls (mock `gh` on PATH dispatches on the request path and cats the fixture bodies verbatim). The freeze step script under test is extracted from the LIVE workflow YAML at run time (fail-closed on restructuring), never copied into the test.
